howto: Edit the postings array in this file, then run: python3 scripts/sync_internships.py  (copies this JSON into index.html). Pay is shown only when the employer posting states it. status must be live, closed, or not_found. For closed or not_found items, set link to the posting if it still exists, otherwise the employer careers page.

postings.title: Engineering/Technical Student
postings.note: Ottawa district, Canadian Buildings. Candidates should be working toward a civil-engineering-related degree or diploma and be eligible for Government of Canada Reliability Status clearance.

postings.title: Project Coordinator
postings.note: A live full-time Project Coordinator posting was found. It is not listed as a student, intern or co-op role. A student-specific posting was not found; check Taggart’s careers page for other openings.

postings.title: Integrated Construction Technology Student
postings.note: Ottawa district, Canadian Buildings. Working toward a degree or diploma in architectural technology or a related field; Revit knowledge is expected. Eligible for Government of Canada Reliability Status clearance.

postings.title: Project Coordinator Co-op
postings.note: Office- and site-based role on a heavy civil infrastructure project in the GTA. For students currently enrolled in Civil Engineering or Construction Management. Posted November 20, 2026.

postings.title: Project Coordinator, Co-op
postings.note: Winter co-op with a January 2027 start. The project is a major civil works program in the Kawartha Lakes and Barrie regions; the posting location is Toronto. For students currently enrolled in Civil Engineering or Construction Management.

postings.title: Co-op, Project Coordinator (Scarborough)
postings.note: Supports underground utility construction projects. For students currently enrolled in a technical diploma or engineering degree (civil, electrical, construction or related). Posted November 11, 2026.

postings.title: Assistant Project Coordinator/Co-op Student (Civil Construction)
postings.type: Co-op · 8 or 12 months preferred · starts January 2027
postings.note: Two locations: Mississauga head office with travel to site, and Pickering fully on site. For full-time students in a related program (for example architectural technology, construction management or civil engineering) or 2026 graduates. A vehicle is required because sites are not easily reached by transit.

postings.title: Estimating Student
postings.note: Toronto District, Canadian Buildings. A second Oakville Estimating Student posting (Solar District) showed as filled on November 25, 2026.

postings.title: Junior Construction Project Coordinator
postings.note: A live full-time entry-level role was found. It is not listed as a student, intern or co-op posting. The posting says co-op placements and internships count toward the experience they ask for.

postings.title: Intern, Project Coordinator (Montreal)
postings.note: Pay is not listed on the posting. For students enrolled in an Engineering or Construction Management program (or graduates within the last six months). A driver's licence, a vehicle and an ASP card are required. Posted September 9, 2026.

postings.title: Winter Estimating Intern
postings.note: French required (the posting asks for maîtrise du français; English is an asset). Posted in French as Stagiaire, estimations (hiver), dated November 7, 2026. For students in a bachelor's program in civil engineering, construction engineering or a related field. Pay is not listed on the posting.
